data.narrative:
Helical Fusion is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Takaya Taguchi and Junichi Miyazawa that has raised $98M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader nuclear energy comp universe of 11 peers—3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy—though direct peer-to-peer comparables at identical stage and valuation tier remain constrained.

Given the limited narrow peer set, stage-progression methodology provides the primary valuation signal. Using the $98M total raised as a value proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement yields an implied valuation of $186M. This method is applicable because it anchors to observed capital deployment patterns within the frontier nuclear sector, where funding rounds reflect market expectations at each stage.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to a single reliable method, supports a valuation range of $158M (low) to $214M (high), with a median point of $186M. Key uncertainties stem from the nascent and heterogeneous nature of the nuclear energy venture landscape; comparable companies vary substantially in technology maturity, regulatory pathway, and capital intensity. A peer-median cross-check was not viable due to insufficient same-stage datapoints. Investors should weight this range alongside qualitative assessment of the company's specific technical differentiation and development timeline.
